decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1/ This purpose built single-family semi-detached dwellinghouse is considered to be of an insufficient size in accordance with the Council's residential conversion guidelines for sub-division, and the conversion would result in the loss of a single-family dwellinghouse for which there is an identified need, contrary to adopted UDP Policy H.1.5 (Revised Deposit January 2001 Policy H.3.4)

Condition : 2 - 2/ The property is situated in an estate where the prevailing character of the area is of purpose built single-family accommodation. The proposed conversion would be out of keeping and detrimental to the character of the area, contrary to adopted UDP Policy ENV.1.1 and H.1.5,  (Revised Deposit January 2001 Policy ENV-B.1.1 and H.3.4).

Condition : 3 - 3/ The proposed two-storey side extension incorporating front porch, by reason of its size, position and appearance would represent an incongruous and obtrusive feature, out of keeping with the character of the original pair of semi-detached properties, resulting in enclosure and detrimental to the appearance of the streetscene, contrary to Adopted UDP policies ENV.1.1, H.3.4 and Revised Deposit Policies ENV-B.1.1 and H.6.4.
description: CONVERSION OF EXISTING DWELLINGHOUSE INTO 2 SELF-CONTAINED FLATS, ERECTION OF SINGLE STOREY REAR EXTENSION AND TWO-STOREY SIDE EXTENSION, INCORPORATING FRONT PORCH.
